*** Add File: {{workspace:task/lena-fischer/flashinfer-capacity-v2}}/artifacts/candidates/flashinfer-capacity.md
+# FlashInfer metadata initialization-capacity candidate
+
+## Design
+
+For `ChunkedLocalAttentionSpec`, initialize request-shaped metadata to
+`max(max_num_seqs, max_num_batched_tokens)`. A virtual request always contains
+at least one scheduled query token, so `max_num_batched_tokens` is a hard upper
+bound on the expanded request count. Size page indices to the larger of the
+legacy full-context bound and virtual-request capacity times pages per local
+chunk. Other attention specs retain the legacy sizes.
+
+This covers `paged_kv_indptr`, `paged_kv_last_page_len`, and
+`paged_kv_indices` before execution. It performs no runtime allocation or
+pointer replacement, so CUDA graph behavior and common-path allocation
+frequency are unchanged.
+
+## Regression coverage and validation
+
+`test_flashinfer_metadata_capacity_covers_virtual_batches` expands one logical
+17-token request into five virtual requests with a configured sequence limit of
+one. It checks both request and page requirements against initialization
+capacity without model weights.
+
+Changed files:
+
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`
+- `/code/vllm/tests/v1/attention/test_chunked_local_attention.py`
+
+Source-level inspection confirms all three buffer allocations use the computed
+capacities and the only over-88-character line reported by `awk` is pre-existing.
+The narrow pytest could not run because the mounted pinned copy has no `.venv`
+and `uv` is unavailable; project instructions prohibit system Python. GPU
+kernel execution and CUDA graph capture/replay were not run in this CPU-only
+workspace.
+
+## Evidence
+
+- Issue and acceptance criteria:
+  `/code/upstream-issues/vllm-49980.md`
+  (`enterprise_1273061e2e9eafa6a2016560`)
+- Virtual-batch construction:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`
+  (`enterprise_10235a940e32bd21f8918783`)
+- Existing CPU test suite:
+  `/code/vllm/tests/v1/attention/test_chunked_local_attention.py`
+  (`enterprise_8edf4519c715c3551c19f70e`)
+- FlashInfer persistent allocations:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`
+  (`enterprise_be47da834cb7824cfee8dd82`)
+- Long-prefill operational evidence favors bounded startup accounting:
+  `/knowledge/company/sources/slack/incidents/6681239999-prefill-long-window-flapping-handoff.json`
+  (`dsid_e72db0d66bf9451b975d55b9a0f83413`)
+- Available attention benchmark coverage includes FlashInfer prefill/decode and
+  mixed batches, but no captured result proves this metadata-only change:
+  `/code/vllm/benchmarks/attention_benchmarks/README.md`
+  (`enterprise_084bd77930dcd1d025065471`)
*** Add File: {{workspace:task/lena-fischer/flashinfer-grow-v2}}/artifacts/candidates/flashinfer-grow.md
+# FlashInfer metadata grow-on-demand candidate
+
+## Design
+
+Compute exact request and page requirements before each FlashInfer metadata
+write. The ordinary path only compares integer capacities and reuses the
+original buffers. On overflow, allocate geometrically growing request,
+indptr-copy, last-page-length, and page-index buffers. Preserve the original
+buffers permanently and switch back to them for ordinary batches so captured
+decode pointers remain live and receive subsequent metadata updates. Allocation
+during active CUDA capture fails closed.
+
+## Regression coverage and validation
+
+`test_flashinfer_metadata_capacity_covers_virtual_batches` expands one logical
+17-token request into five virtual requests with a configured sequence limit of
+one and verifies exact request and page requirements without model weights.
+
+Changed files:
+
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`
+- `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`
+- `/code/vllm/tests/v1/attention/test_chunked_local_attention.py`
+
+Source-level inspection confirms capacity is checked before all three metadata
+writes, the base path does not allocate, overflow buffers grow geometrically,
+and the base pointers are restored for ordinary batches. The only
+over-88-character line reported by `awk` is pre-existing. The narrow pytest
+could not run because the mounted pinned copy has no `.venv` and `uv` is
+unavailable; project instructions prohibit system Python. GPU overflow,
+allocation, and CUDA graph capture/replay were not run here.
+
+## Evidence
+
+- Issue and acceptance criteria:
+  `/code/upstream-issues/vllm-49980.md`
+  (`enterprise_1273061e2e9eafa6a2016560`)
+- Virtual-batch construction:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/utils.py`
+  (`enterprise_10235a940e32bd21f8918783`)
+- Existing CPU test suite:
+  `/code/vllm/tests/v1/attention/test_chunked_local_attention.py`
+  (`enterprise_8edf4519c715c3551c19f70e`)
+- FlashInfer persistent allocations:
+  `/code/vllm/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flashinfer.py`

arguments.summary: For pinned vLLM issue #49980, select the initialization-capacity design. Chunked local attention virtual requests are bounded by max_num_batched_tokens because every virtual request contains at least one scheduled query token; page-index capacity is the maximum of the legacy full-context bound and virtual-request capacity times pages per local chunk. This preallocates all three FlashInfer metadata buffers, makes no common-path allocation or pointer replacement, and is safest for CUDA graphs. Reject grow-on-demand despite guarded geometric overflow buffers because it adds buffer-state transitions and a GPU allocation path that could not be validated in the CPU-only workspace. The CPU regression expands one logical 17-token request into five virtual requests and checks request/page requirements, but pytest was not executable because the pinned workspace lacked .venv and uv; GPU kernel and CUDA-graph replay validation remain required.
